TODDLER 2

18–24 months: first concepts.

The Toddler 2 class. Around this age toddlers love spotting differences — big and little, up and down, full and empty — so this lesson pairs twelve realistic pictures into six concepts you can name clearly while your toddler looks.

Age 18–24 MonthsClass Toddler 2Subjects Thinking, comparison, talk
Lesson 8Think & Talk

First Concepts

Big and small, up and down, full and empty — concept pairs in realistic pictures, ready for a short game of say it and look. Three to five playful minutes.
